D: Two divorce mediators crash weddings for fun, until they fall for the daughters of a powerful politician.
P: Serve the mains when the Cleary family sits down to dinner.
S: Warm little blini topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, salmon roe and chives, passed round on silver trays like a proper reception. Warm 20 blini at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of half a lemon and a pinch of salt. Spoon a little onto each blini, top with a ribbon of smoked salmon from 200g, a few beads of salmon roe and chopped chives. Finish with cracked pepper and serve straight away on a tray.
Crab meat folded with a little mayo, egg, mustard, celery salt, paprika and breadcrumbs, shaped, chilled, pan-fried in butter until golden. Lemon.
the sailing trip that ends badly
Cooked prawns chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon juice, celery and chives, piled into soft rolls toasted in butter on the cut sides.
M: Beef and pork meatloaf with grated onion, egg and Worcestershire, glazed sticky with tomato and brown sugar, with buttery mash and gravy. Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, a grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and salt and press into a loaf tin. Spread with 80ml tomato sauce mixed with 2 tbsp brown sugar. Bake at 180C for 1 hour and rest 10 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Simmer the pan juices with 250ml beef stock and 1 tbsp flour for gravy.

Pan-roasted chicken breasts with a white wine, mustard and tarragon cream sauce, potato gratin and green beans. Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Pan-roast 4 chicken breasts. Add 150ml white wine, 1 tbsp Dijon and tarragon to the pan, then 150ml cream. Serve with 300g green beans.
W: no excuses, play like a champion

Vanilla butter cake baked at 165C, split and layered with raspberry jam and Swiss meringue buttercream (egg whites and sugar heated to 70C, whipped, butter beaten in), served in fingers. Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 165C for 30 minutes. Heat 3 whites and 150g sugar to 70C, whip, then beat in 250g butter. Layer with raspberry jam and cut into fingers.
K: the toast at every reception they crash

Gin shaken with fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup, strained into a flute and topped with cold sparkling wine and a long lemon twist. Chill a 750ml bottle of sparkling wine for three hours. For each drink, shake 30ml gin, 15ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup with ice. Strain into a flute and top slowly with about 90ml sparkling wine. Add a long twist of lemon peel and raise them high while someone gives a speech.

s.how: Fold 400g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, celery salt, paprika and 50g breadcrumbs. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Pan-fry in 40g butter until golden and serve with lemon.

s.note: the sailing trip that ends badly
s.how: Chop 400g cooked prawns and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a finely diced celery stick and chives. Butter the cut sides of 4 hot dog buns and toast. Pile the prawns in.
